description: Canonical, unified task / work-item model shared by every task-bearing component (Gantt, Notion tasks, external work-item blocks, scheduler). A single ITmWorkItemProvider supplies these so the same item can appear consistently across components within one application.

members.name: Duration
members.description: Computed duration (End − Start).

members.name: HasParent
members.description: Whether this item has a parent.

members.name: ActualCost
members.description: Actual monetary cost incurred so far.

members.name: Assignees
members.description: People assigned to this item.

members.name: Attachments
members.description: Files attached to this item.

members.name: BudgetHours
members.description: Planned effort in hours (for budget tracking).

members.name: Color
members.description: Bar/accent color as a CSS color string. Null uses the default.

members.name: Comments
members.description: Comment entries on this item.

members.name: CreatedAt
members.description: Creation timestamp.

members.name: CustomFields
members.description: User-defined custom field values keyed by field id.

members.name: Description
members.description: Rich-text or plain description.

members.name: DueDate
members.description: Optional due date / deadline.

members.name: End
members.description: Planned end. Defaults to MinValue for unscheduled sources.

members.name: EstimationHours
members.description: Estimated effort in hours.

members.name: ExternalId
members.description: Provider-native identifier (e.g. DEMO-101, issue number) when sourced externally.

members.name: Fields
members.description: Opaque provider-specific fields shown only by consumers that understand them.

members.name: Id
members.description: Stable identifier of the work item.

members.name: IsCompleted
members.description: Convenience completed flag (kept in sync by consumers; Done status implies completed).

members.name: IsExpanded
members.description: UI state: whether children are expanded (relevant for parent items).

members.name: IsMilestone
members.description: When true, the item is rendered as a milestone (diamond).

members.name: LoggedHours
members.description: Actually logged hours.

members.name: OriginBlockId
members.description: Source block identifier, when applicable.

members.name: OriginPageId
members.description: Source page identifier (e.g. Notion page), when applicable.

members.name: OriginPageTitle
members.description: Source page title, when applicable.

members.name: ParentId
members.description: Parent work item identifier. Null for root-level items.

members.name: PercentComplete
members.description: Completion percentage (0–100).

members.name: Priority
members.description: Unified priority.

members.name: PriorityLabel
members.description: Provider-native priority label, when richer than the unified enum.

members.name: SourceKey
members.description: Key of the source/provider this item belongs to (registry discriminator).

members.name: Start
members.description: Planned start. Defaults to MinValue for unscheduled sources (e.g. Notion tasks, which use DueDate instead).

members.name: Status
members.description: Unified workflow status.

members.name: StatusColor
members.description: Status color token or sanitized CSS color supplied by the provider.

members.name: StatusLabel
members.description: Provider-native status label, when richer than the unified enum.

members.name: Tags
members.description: Free-form tags / labels captured as shared tag references.

members.name: TimeLog
members.description: Time log entries recorded against this item.

members.name: Title
members.description: Display title.

members.name: TypeIconUrl
members.description: Optional icon URL for the item type.

members.name: TypeLabel
members.description: Provider-native item type label (e.g. Bug, Story).

members.name: UpdatedAt
members.description: Last updated timestamp reported by the provider.

members.name: Url
members.description: Absolute URL to the source item, when available.

members.name: UseManualDates
members.description: When false (default), a group bar spans min(Start)→max(End) of its direct children. Set to true to use this item's own Start/End regardless of children.
